description: Source code for a web scraper class 'USAPears' that extracts recipe information from usapears.org, including author, total time, ingredients, nutrient info, and ratings.

classes.name: USAPears
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from usapears.org

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the author of the recipe, either from schema or meta tags

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total preparation and cooking time from recipe legend elements

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes list of ingredients from the HTML

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients based on HTML structure

methods.name: nutrients
methods.description: Extracts nutritional information, correcting common key mistakes

methods.name: ratings
methods.description: Calculates average rating from comment rating elements
